[EN] Keeping an Eye Out
[ES] Vigilar el perímetro
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Thin out the reavers, and we'll have safe passage.
[ES] Reduce el número de saqueadores y tendremos un paso seguro.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] We're actually pretty safe here.
[ES] La verdad es que aquí estamos bastante seguros.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Kill argonomorth Lokian reavers east of {@Rgn:45006$$Field Base Reciprocity}.
[ES] Mata a los saqueadores lokian argonomorfos al este de {@Rgn:45006$$Field Base Reciprocity}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Glad I could help."
[ES] Me alegra poder ayudar.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to {@Rgn:45011$$Swampwatch Camp} through the cave near {@Rgn:45006$$Field Base Reciprocity}, and make sure {@creature:245#1026$$Setahl} is safe.
[ES] Ve al {@Rgn:45011$$Swampwatch Camp} a través de la cueva cerca de {@Rgn:45006$$Field Base Reciprocity} y asegúrate de que {@creature:245#1026$$Setahl} esté a salvo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
